final_claim.narrative: A time-respecting route from 275 to 1707 exists within [44240,82639] with successive waits [362, 154, 257, 286] — all ≤ 600 (step_01), so a cascade is supported. Requiring a stricter max_wait of 300 breaks reachability (step_02), which controls for the alternative that only very short hops would validate transmission.
